description: This file defines the PdfContent class, which manages the content streams of a PDF page within the PDFsharp library for .NET. It provides methods for handling compression, decoding, and graphical state preservation of PDF content streams.

classes.name: PdfContent
classes.description: Represents the content of a PDF page, supporting content stream management including compression, decoding, and graphics state handling.

methods.name: PdfContent
methods.description: Constructor initializing PdfContent with a PdfDocument.

methods.name: PdfContent
methods.description: Internal constructor initializing PdfContent with a PdfPage.

methods.name: PdfContent
methods.description: Constructor initializing PdfContent with a PdfDictionary (for legacy or low-level access).

methods.name: Compressed
methods.description: Property to enable or disable compression of the content stream using Flate (ZIP) encoding.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Method to unfilter the content stream if it is compressed/encrypted.

methods.name: PreserveGraphicsState
methods.description: Method to wrap the content stream with save/restore graphics state operators if necessary.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Method to write the content object to a PDF stream, applying compression if enabled.

methods.name: SetRenderer
methods.description: Method to associate an XGraphicsPdfRenderer with this content, for rendering purposes.
